config.bridge: betweenness centrality on the directed seeding network
config.left_censoring: seeding sub-signal biased by 1995 panel start; flow + betweenness sub-signals are not
config.panel_conditional: roles are within-panel; true source generalists (Nature/NEJM/Lancet) are not in the corpus
config.role_rule: argmax of z-scored {source, bridge, terminal}; ties source>bridge>terminal
config.velocity: years from publication to citation (citing_year - pub_year)
